REVIEWS -- both Google listings opened live in Chrome and the Unreplied list read on screen. THE BREWHOUSE (4.5, 526 reviews) has FOUR unanswered reviews, up from the 1 reported yesterday. Dinner was 61.2% of net at $49.08 per order, Lunch 35.1% at $40.65. Patio + Front Patio combined were 35.5% of net -- the outdoor seats are carrying real weight. Draft beer moved 106 items for $886. FRIDAY AUG 21 IS PENDING: Toast delivers ~6:30-7:40 AM PT, so a 4 AM run structurally cannot have it.

SLING -- Saturday Aug 22's roster has not been delivered (arrives ~7:00 AM PT). Last delivered roster is Friday Aug 21: 10 employees, 10 shifts, 55.25 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime, 0 employees off, kitchen covered. No coverage or OT problems in the last known data.

YELP -- no customer inquiries; two consumer marketing blasts only. GOOGLE ADS -- 2 routine report emails, no disapprovals or budget alerts. TRIPADVISOR -- nothing new.

unanswered.draftReply: Donald, I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell and I'm taking this seriously. I'd like to look into your visit directly -- please reach me at the restaurant at (805) 884-4664 or mojobrewhouse@gmail.com so I can get the details. Food safety is something we don't take lightly, and I want to follow up personally. -- Joal, Owner
unanswered.handlingNote: DO NOT POST WITHOUT REVIEW. Public allegation of foodborne illness. Recommend: (1) pull the Aug 8 lunch ticket and taco prep/temp logs before responding, (2) notify your insurance carrier, (3) consider a quick call with counsel. Never admit or deny causation in a public reply -- acknowledge, express concern, move it offline.
